sources.title: FastConformer explained: subsampling, local attention, streaming, TDT
sources.snippet: An independent, source-checked explainer of NVIDIA's FastConformer encoder: 8x depthwise-separable subsampling, limited-context attention with a global token, cache-aware streaming, and the CTC, RNN-T and TDT decoders used in Parakeet.
